tasks_completed.description: Show empty droppable slot when accommodation is explicitly deselected
tasks_completed.changes: Changed outer gate from {day.accommodation && (} to an IIFE that also renders when editorSelections[day:accommodation]===null AND editorDay.accommodation exists. Array initializer changed from [day.accommodation]||[] to [day.accommodation]||[{}] to render empty card. Added empty-state visual (italic grey placeholder) when acc.name_base and acc.name_local are both absent.
tasks_completed.rationale: After dragging board card to sidebar, day.accommodation=null hides the entire Section including .slot-drop, leaving no drop target. Fix: render section with empty placeholder card (with droppable .slot-drop) when explicitly deselected.

self_verification.notes: Playwright verified: slot_drop_visible=true after deselect, data-droppable=true, Section header still present.
